scope: Mobile homepage direct article navigation and synchronous search dialog opening, lazy search loading, touch selection and viewport handling.
status: Local verification passed; commit and push authorized.

conditions.chrome: Existing owned browser-act Chrome session; native clicks and input, same-origin iframes at 320, 390 and 640 CSS px.
conditions.safari: Safari 27.0 on macOS, Responsive Design Mode at 390×844 and 320×360. Native UI input, clicks and screenshots.
conditions.faults: Local-only static server delayed the search chunk by 8000ms and separately returned 503 for the module and index.
conditions.synthetic: Composition boundaries and touch pointer movement use DOM events. Keyboard occupancy is simulated by shrinking Visual Viewport height and changing offsetTop.
conditions.limits: No physical iPhone or iOS simulator. Desktop WebKit and viewport simulation cannot verify a real iOS keyboard or touch event sequence.
